answer: The summit lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the island is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The quill of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
